Noisy Page Pasta

A pasta recipe hidden among many unrelated blocks.

Ingredients

  • 200 g pasta
  • 150 g cherry tomatoes
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 clove garlic
  • 30 g parmesan
  • 1 pinch basil

Instructions

  1. Boil pasta in salted water until al dente.
  2. Cook garlic and tomatoes in olive oil.
  3. Toss pasta with the sauce and parmesan.
  4. Finish the dish with basil before serving.
